answer: A tight ring of 81 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the ember calculation reruns each epoch, the ridge weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the ledge settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 37% independent neighbours on the funding graph. That is 5 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
